cards.headline: The factory tests. What does the brand do?
body: For OEM production in Korea, the brand receives and manages test results.

sourceTrace.heading: 공장이 맡는 품질검사와 브랜드 회사에 남는 일

cards.design: 검사 완료 문서와 받는 쪽을 연결한다. 표지는 질문과 직접 답만 남긴다.

cards.headline: Know what each business must do

body.text: It tests raw materials, supplies and finished products. It also prepares and keeps manufacturing and quality-control records.
The brand oversees the contractor. It receives and manages results for each batch and the related records.

sourceTrace.heading: 공장이 맡는 품질검사와 브랜드 회사에 남는 일

cards.takeaway: Sharing costs by contract does not transfer duties under the Cosmetics Act.
cards.design: 두 역할을 위아래 넓은 행으로 비교. 시험과 기록, 감독과 결과 관리를 문장 단위로 구분. 비용 약정과 법정 의무 결론 보존.

cards.headline: When may you skip a separate test?

body.text: The manufacturer and responsible distributor are the same business.
For separate businesses, testing must be entrusted to a legally eligible testing provider, with results available for each batch.

sourceTrace.heading: 그렇다면 같은 제품을 두 번 검사해야 할까요?

cards.takeaway: Oversight, record management and final-product quality duties remain.
cards.design: OR 두 갈래. 검사위탁 갈래 안의 법정기관·제조번호별결과는 AND로 묶는다.

cards.headline: “Test complete”: check the delivery

body.text: Check the batch number of the goods delivered, not just the product name.
Match the results to that batch number. If only the product name appears, ask for records for that batch.

sourceTrace.heading: ‘검사 완료’라는 메일과 납품 상자의 번호가 맞지 않는다면

cards.takeaway: Oversight, record management and final-product quality duties remain.
cards.design: 상자와 검사자료의 제조번호 위치를 같은 색 테두리로 연결. 실제 번호를 창작하지 않음.

cards.headline: Agree how test records reach you
body: Agree who tests and how to check results for the batches being delivered.
Agree who provides and reviews the required product specification documents and quality-control records, and when.
Keep the records under the company’s quality-control rules.

sourceTrace.heading: ‘검사 완료’라는 메일과 납품 상자의 번호가 맞지 않는다면

cards.takeaway: Receiving records is not the same as judging whether the test results meet the required standards.
cards.design: 제조번호→자료전달→보관의 흐름을 세 행으로 연결. 옛4·5번의 반복을 합친다.

cards.headline: What if the approved specifications change?

body.text: Document the approved sample, product specifications, container, packaging and required test standards.
For changes that may affect quality, you may agree on advance notice and delivery of relevant records, then confirm the change and its effective date in writing.

sourceTrace.heading: 샘플을 승인한 다음 제품 사양이 달라진다면

cards.takeaway: Align notification and approval procedures and name the internal reviewer. Further testing depends on the change.
cards.design: 기존사양과 변경약정을 구분. 후자를 일률적 법정절차처럼 표현하지 않는다.

cards.headline: Sharing quality records

body.text: Give the responsible distributor necessary quality-control information from manufacturing and quality records.
Submission may be omitted if both are the same business.
The manufacturer designs, develops and produces the product. Omission must not affect quality or safety management. The information is a trade secret under both parties’ contract.

cards.takeaway: Submission may be omitted only within the statutory exception’s scope.
cards.design: 원칙과 두 예외를 구분하고 별개 사업자의 세 조건 모두를 같은 장에 명시. 설명 폭 확보를 위해 장식 아이콘 생략.

cards.headline: Separate businesses: meet all three conditions

body.text: The manufacturer must design, develop and produce the product.
Omission must not affect quality or safety management.
The information must be a trade secret under the contract between both parties.

cards.takeaway: Submission may be omitted only where all three apply, and only within that scope. A trade-secret claim is no blanket exemption.
cards.design: 잠금 이모티콘 뒤 세 조건을 한 묶음으로 연결. 모두라는 글자와 가능 표현 유지.

cards.headline: Compare three documents before signing

body.text: “The responsible sales manager checks test records”

sourceTrace.heading: 다시 첫 견적서를 펼쳐보면 무엇이 달라질까요?

cards.takeaway: Align the people responsible and record-delivery timing across all three documents.
cards.note: Illustrative wording. For specification changes, results that differ from agreed standards or post-sale inquiries, check whom to consult and who handles the records.
cards.design: 세 문서의 원문 인용을 그대로 두고 상자 높이를 조정해 상황별 협의·자료 담당자 설명 공간 확보.

cards.headline: Before signing, start with what you have

body.text: Send any quotation, draft contract, test-report delivery guidance or quality-control rules you already have.
Ethos Administrative Attorney Office checks who tests, how batch results reach you, the people named in the contract and quality-control rules, and what still needs agreement.

sourceTrace.heading: 직접 준비할 수 있는 부분과 맡길 수 있는 문서 작업

cards.takeaway: Drafting contracts and related documents is a paid service. Scope and fees are agreed separately.
cards.design: 자료와 검토범위 두단. 무료검토와 유료작성 구분을 하단에 명확히 남긴다.
